articles.summary: USA TODAY welcomes new editorial leaders and reporters across entertainment, culture, style, beauty and new media to further expand entertainment coverage. These additions reflect USA TODAY’s continued investment in premium entertainment, lifestyle and culture journalism, while expanding coverage of the topics and personalities shaping today’s media landscape. Charlie Carballo joins as West Coast Editor, based in Los Angeles. Most recently Executive Digital Director at Women’s Wear Daily, Carballo brings extensive experience overseeing breaking news coverage, audience development, SEO and analytics. Paris Close joins as Weekend Editor. Based in Grand Rapids, Michigan, Close served as a copy editor at Stacker Media, where he was known for his expertise in entertainment and pop culture coverage. He has also held editorial roles at iHeartRadio and PopCrush. Sameen Chaudhry joins as Breaking & Trending Reporter.
